title: Avnet Gains From Global AI Infrastructure Demand: What's Ahead?
author: Na
description: Avnet (AVT) continues to capitalize on robust AI infrastructure demand, with fiscal 2026 IP&E sales reaching $4.6 billion, up from $4 billion. The company expects fiscal 2027 Q1 adjusted EPS of $2.80-$2.90, representing 241% year-over-year growth. title: AVT Jumps 37.8% in 6 Months: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
author: Na
description: Avnet reported record fourth-quarter sales of $8.3 billion, up 48% year-over-year, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand across data centers, networking, and industrial markets. The company's adjusted operating margin expanded to 3.8%, with healthy backlog and book-to-bill ratios. Despite a 37.8% six-month stock rally, AVT trades below industry valuation multiples, earning a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

title: VinFast, Alcoa, And Regencell Are Among the Top 10 Large-Cap Gainers Last Week (March 30-April 2): Are the Others in Your Portfolio?
author: Nabaparna Bhattacharya
description: U.S. large-cap stocks posted strong gains during the shortened week of March 30-April 2. VinFast Auto led with a 42.77% jump driven by strong EV momentum and Canadian rebates. Alcoa gained 24.12% on bullish commodities sentiment amid Middle East conflict resolution expectations. Other notable gainers included SBA Communications (23.22%), Equinox Gold (20.98%), and several precious metals miners, with gains ranging from 15-19%.
